category_title: Students with advanced decoding skills disengaged by traditional print media
minimal_context: The tutor and student sit down together in the reception class to read a traditional print reading book.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Harry, I have a reading book for us today. Let's sit down and read it together.

STUDENT: (Stares at the reading book and does nothing)

TUTOR: Can you try reading the first page for me?

STUDENT: (Sits quietly, concealing his ability to read the words on the page)

TUTOR: What do you think this word says? Keep trying.

STUDENT: Oh that's boring I don't want to read that.

options.A: Use the iPad app 'Doodlefind' where every single word flashes up for the student.
options.B: Ignore all undesirable behaviors exhibited by the student during the reading book activity.
options.C: Instruct the student to look at or point to the words in the book.
options.D: Provide a touch on the student's shoulder during the reading book activity.
